where: 13.2, 'qu'on dénotera par X̂ et appelera le complété formel de X'
note: Spelling error of the typescript (appeler doubles the l before a mute e). The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: first paragraph, 'ne dépend en fait que de la restriction de X à un voisinage ouvert arbitraire U de S.'
scan: U de S. (a capital S, as tall as the U)
note: A neighbourhood of the point s is meant: X̂ is built from the infinitesimal neighbourhoods S_n of s, and 13.2.1 restricts 'au-dessus d'un voisinage ouvert U variable de s'; the only neighbourhood of S in S is S. The TeX keeps the printed capital S.

where: display after 'Considérons en effet la suite exacte'
note: The last glyph is the typewriter capital C (open on the right, with the top serif of the C of 'Compte'), wider than the narrow closed O typed for 0 at the start of the line. The sequence 'analogue à (13.1.3)' ends in 0, as (13.1.3) does on p. 485. The TeX keeps the printed C.

where: '(où E_s et E'_s sont les O_s-modules libres fibres en s'
scan: E̲_s et E'_s: the first E is underlined, the second is typed without underline
note: Both are the free O_s-modules, stalks of the Modules E̲, E̲' (written E̲_s, E̲'_s in the displays of F̂ and F); plain E'_s is the fibre of the vector bundle E'. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: same sentence, 'fibres en s des O_s-Modules E, E''
scan: O̲_s-Modules with a small s (compare the capital S of O̲_S on p. 489)
note: E̲, E̲' are sheaves of modules on S (Modules with capital M), i.e. O_S-Modules; O_s is the local ring at s. The TeX keeps the printed small s.

What R_o generates by Nakayama is the completed module Ê̲_s, the source of F̂ in the display above, where it is underlined; the inclusion F̂(E̲_s) ⊂ E̲'_s that follows is underlined too. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

where: Corollaire 13.2.2, 'les conditions a), b), c) de 13.2.2'
note: Conditions a), b), c) are those of Lemme 13.2.1; as printed, the corollary cites itself. The TeX keeps the printed number.

where: 13.3, 'Supposons donné A comme dans 13.1, avec A = A_o'
scan: A = A_o (the o set low as an index, like the o of R_o after it)
note: Condition a) of 13.2.1 (A = A^o) is meant; A_o is the fibre at s (cf. 'la fibre A_s = A_o' on p. 490). The TeX keeps the printed index.

where: 13.3, 'et considérons R_o = R_3, qui est un Z-module libre de type fini'
scan: R_o = R_3 (the index has the flat top of the typewriter 3 of '13.3.', not the round s of R_s in (13.3.2))
note: The fibre R_s of R at s is meant (cf. 'R_s = R_o' on p. 488). The TeX keeps the printed 3.

where: 'toute section de O_S dont le germe en s est nul soit nul'
note: Gender slip: the second adjective refers to 'toute section' (feminine). The TeX keeps the printed reading.
